title: Policy question, then asks for a person

turns.customer: Quick question before I use Paylane for something big: how do refunds work? Is there a limit?
turns.reply: Each card purchase is judged on its own. I can refund a settled purchase myself if it's $75.00 or less, under 30 days old and not already refunded. Bigger or older purchases aren't automatically refused; they go to a person on our support team for review. There's no cap on how many separate purchases can be refunded, and every refund is for the full amount.
